capabilities: Add a Bookshelf view type to Bases
Display notes with cover images on shelves
Generate default CSS book covers and spines
Group notes into separate shelves via groupBy
Show properties and clickable wikilinks per book
extras: Full documentation lives in docs/ and is published on the author's site; a one-time post-update dialog shows release notes and support/donation links. Requires Obsidian 1.4.0 or newer.
intentEvidence: adds a Bookshelf view type to Obsidian Bases
problem: Obsidian Bases only offers table, card, and gallery layouts, so cover-driven collections like books, movies, or games lack a visual bookshelf view.
summary: Custom Bases view that displays notes as a visual bookshelf with real or generated book covers on realistic shelves.
